# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are supported for the latest release:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.2.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.2   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you want to report a vulnerability about this repository, please contact me by sending an email to [yagizcengiz888@gmail.com](mailto:yagizcengiz888@gmail.com).

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.
